items.name: agentconnect
items.description: The open-source, multi-agent alternative to Claude Tag.  @ any agent, wherever work happens, they work alongside your team, learning as they go.

items.name: airbyte
items.description: Open-source data movement for ELT pipelines and AI agents — from APIs, databases & files to warehouses, lakes, and AI applications. Both self-hosted and Cloud.

items.name: deer-flow
items.description: An open-source long-horizon SuperAgent harness that researches, codes, and creates. With the help of sandboxes, memories, tools, skill, subagents and message gateway, it handles different levels of tasks that could take minutes to hours.

items.name: aweb
items.description: Communication for AI agents: stable identity, durable mail and chat, and wake-up events across sessions, runtimes, machines, and organizations. MIT, self-hostable.

items.name: kody
items.description: 🐨 Your agents' cloud — the memory, keys, code, and automations your AI agent keeps, portable across every MCP host.

items.name: hol-guard
items.description: Open-source antivirus for AI agents: block risky tools, secret access, prompt injection, malicious packages, MCP servers, plugins, and skills at runtime.

items.name: openrig
items.description: Build your own network of agents from Claude Code, Codex and Pi: persistent teams with roles, shared context and owned work.

items.name: hermes-agent-orange-book
items.description: Hermes Agent 从入门到精通 · 橙皮书系列 · Nous Research 开源 AI Agent 框架实战指南

items.name: amux
items.description: Open-source control plane for AI coding agents. Run an AI engineering team: parallel Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini workers with a shared board, atomic tasks, schedules, loops, origin-stamped messaging, model switching, and self-healing recovery. One dashboard, or your phone. MIT, single Rust binary.

items.name: genoffice
items.description: Free, open-source AI Office suite: Docs, Sheets, Slides, PDF, Markdown and HTML editors with a built-in AI agent, plus a `genoffice` CLI and agent skill so Claude Code, Codex and Cursor can create and edit real .docx/.xlsx/.pptx files locally. Bring your own key. macOS, Windows & Linux.
